en: Dependent on a state with applied thought (*savitakkadhamma*), a state without applied thought (*nasavitakkadhamma*) arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*) ... three.
Dependent on a state without applied thought (*avitakkadhamma*), a state without sustained thought (*naavitakkadhamma*) arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are nine ... pe ... under prenascence and repetition there are six ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are nine.
Dependent on a state with sustained thought (*savicāra*), a state without sustained thought (*na-savicāra*) arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*) ... three.
Dependent on a state without sustained thought (*avicāra*), a state not without sustained thought (*na-avicāra*) arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are nine ... pe ... under prenascence (*purejāta*) and repetition (*āsevana*) there are six ... pe ... under non-disappearance (*avigata*) there are nine.
